ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field with high-intensity (white) focal spots occupying approximately 12-15% of the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white spots (mottling) ranging from 3-15 pixels in diameter are semi-randomly distributed across the mid-field of both lobes, with significantly higher density clusters localized at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 74 degrees and a vertical pixel depth equivalent to 1/6th of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrations with pixel amplitudes of 2-8 pixels along the entire boundary; distinctive larger indentations are present on the medial-to-distal section of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral convex curves sweeping upward and outward from the central notch, terminating in sharp, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, matching the profile of barnacle-induced scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and heavy white cicatrization at both distal tips, resulting in a ragged, non-linear terminal boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: A localized cluster of four high-intensity spots forming a near-perfect square in the upper-mid region of the right lobe.
